thread:
alex-hiringmgr: Heads-up — candidate asking to start 2026-04-02. Hiring manager requesting a comp-band exception (L4 -> L5 effective comp) plus $12k sign-on to bridge visa-dependent timing. Can we fast-track? cc @jen-peopleops @sam-recruiter
jen-peopleops: Need the justification packet before routing. Please include manager rationale, market comps, approved interview scorecard, and proposed payout schedule for the sign-on. If visa-related, include dependent timing note.
sam-recruiter: I have market comps and the interview packet. Candidate prefers earlier start due to spouse visa transfer. I'll drop links in a sec: https://redwood.internal/comp/compare/279123
alex-hiringmgr: pasted market comps + manager note here: base current offer $180k, proposed base $186k + $12k lump sign-on. Manager says role critical for Q2 launch.
maya-peopleops: Tagging comp-committee — @comp-committee please advise on: 1) pay equity impact, 2) policy exception acceptability for bump, 3) sign-on approval path. Also confirm whether sign-on should be split across payroll.
comp-committee: Confirm received. We'll need a one-paragraph business case and the peer comp table. If approved, final offer must record exception code EXC-COMP-2026-04.
offer-bot: Offer Approval Submitted: ID OP-2026-089 (auto). Routing to comp-committee.
jen-peopleops: Quick note on timelines: payroll cutoff for 4/2 start is 2026-03-29 for first paycheck alignment. Benefits enrollment deadline to have benefits effective 5/1 is 2026-04-15. If sign-on is > $10k must route to finance for GL code.
sam-recruiter: I can assemble the one-paragraph biz case and upload the peer comp CSV by EOD today. Would manager sign off in thread suffice?
alex-hiringmgr: Manager signoff: "I approve the adjusted comp and sign-on as proposed. Candidate is mission-critical for the launch and would decline otherwise." — alex (hiring mgr).
maya-peopleops: For expedited review, use the accelerate form: /pay-exception-expedite OP-2026-089 and attach docs. If chair greenlights, committee can respond within 24 hrs. Otherwise standard queue ~3 business days.
alex-hiringmgr: Filing expedite now. Please ping if you need more. Candidate is waiting on final by tomorrow.
jen-peopleops: Got it. Pinged the chair and finance. Will update thread when we have a call outcome. :thumbsup:
comp-committee: Chair reviewed prelim docs, requests brief on retention plan if we approve this uplift. Can manager add 2–3 lines about retention milestones?
alex-hiringmgr: Added retention milestones to the packet. Thanks.
jen-peopleops: Update — finance approved GL routing for sign-on split 50/50 across first two pay periods, chair approved pay-band uplift as exception EXC-COMP-2026-04. Final signatures inbound.
offer-bot: Offer Approval Completed: OP-2026-089 — exception granted.
alex-hiringmgr: Amazing — thank you everyone. I'll send the signed offer and confirm candidate accept.
sam-recruiter: Will send offer within the hour and mark candidate start 04/02. Noted benefits effective 05/01.
maya-peopleops: Closing loop: ensure exception note in HRIS and tag for 6-month compensation review.
jen-peopleops: Copy — I'll create the review reminder task. :white_check_mark:
